patch_description:
The current surrogate uses a 75/25 direct-demand blend, 2–4 affinity-selected paths plus one low-pressure alternative, and a fixed 0.46 path reward. Its negative-only interactions can overvalue redundant coverage.

This version retains sparse path selection but ranks intermediates using both total and balanced leg demand. It adds a damped second-order correction for direct-versus-two-hop redundancy, so completing a triangle is less attractive when the direct link already serves its endpoint demand. Path rewards decrease mildly with network size, while the degree-penalty weight increases from 1.25 to 1.45. These changes target topology and exchange ranking without adding degree penalties or rewarding reciprocal links. Performance improvements require evaluation.
